description_full: Forge Nano Holdings Inc. develops and manufactures atomic layer deposition equipment and provides surface engineering solutions for materials at both research and commercial scales. The company provides atomic layer deposition equipment and solutions for applying precision coatings to materials such as semiconductor wafers, ultra-high surface area powders, filters, membranes, and optical elements. It offers proprietary ALD platforms and tools, including Prometheus, Theia, Pandora, and Lithos systems, for lab-scale and commercial-scale applications. The company delivers end-to-end services, including concept validation, lab-scale proof-of-concept, commercial production, custom solution development, process refinement, ongoing maintenance, support contracts, and white label manufacturing. It also provides protective thin film and conformal coating services for electronics and electrical products. The company serves industrial and professional clients in sectors such as semiconductors, batteries, magnetics, pharmaceuticals, microelectronics, and optical components, as well as research and development laboratories, universities, and commercial manufacturing operations. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Thornton, Colorado with an additional location in Morrisville, North Carolina.
